title: Design indexed touched-closure admission for task-sync graph changes
outcome: Specify a source-backed graph overlay and indexed closure that can validate changed task documents without visiting disconnected project tasks.
acceptance: Map existing forward and reverse parent, required-child, prerequisite, replacement and origin queries and indexes to a complete touched-closure algorithm, including deletions and cycles through unchanged tasks.
Identify each whole-project capture or graph scan in folder admission and Model A paths, and name the existing owner that will replace it; no duplicate domain rules or graph validator.
Define counters and fixture cases proving exact relevant nodes and edges visited, retained references read separately, disconnected tasks untouched, and native/run/seal/history refusals preserved.

Record whether existing indexes suffice. Any new projection derivation or durable schema/record change gets a concrete repair or migration plan for Fable and Greg before implementation; this design item changes no source.

completion.summary: Delivered indexed touched-closure design and current-source scan mapping; incorporated Codex16737/Fable1371 clarifications including adjacency requery and field-classified graph work. Design only, no source/store changes or execution credit.
